Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Some call these decks battleships. When it comes to system security and fortified anti-theft protocols, it's a foolproof piece of machinery.

Neuroport Cyberdeck Port Operating System. The Neuroport Cyberdeck Port can now only accept a Raven Microcybernetics Mk.3 Viral Cyberdeck, one of which is provided with purchase of this Operating System.

The Mk.3 Viral is a Cyberdeck with 6 slots that can install Programs or Hardware. Once per Round when a Quickhack from this Cyberdeck is successfully used on a target, the user may immediately attempt that Quickhack again without a Net Action on another valid target within 12m/yds of the first target whom they already have access to.

Slots: 6

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
